item.title: Nearly £3m for West Midlands road marking framework
item.description: Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council has tendered a new £2.9m framework for the provision of superimposed road markings, specialist surfacing (high friction) and studs for three West Midlands areas.

item.title: Blakedale opens first Scottish site
item.description: Traffic management and safety vehicle provider Blakedale has opened a new branch in Glasgow, marking the company's first permanent location in Scotland.

item.title: ITS Nationals chair to step down
item.description: Donal Hodgins has announced he will step down as chair of ITS Nationals, the international network of national Intelligent Transport Systems associations, at the end of his current term.

item.title: New Scotland and North England director for WSP
item.description: Iain McDonald has been appointed by WSP as director of Scotland and North England, after spending ‘six rewarding years' working with Clackmannanshire Council.

item.title: West Midlands Combined Authority names new chief executive
item.description: The West Midlands Combined Authority (WMCA) has confirmed Ed Cox as its chief executive after his successful tenure in an interim capacity saw a boost to regional transport and infrastructure plans.

item.title: National Highways' legacy fund helps men's charity stay at the cutting edge
item.description: National Highways has provided a grant to Ross-on-Wye men's charity, Men's Shed, which invites retired and semi-retired men to make an active contribution to the local community by repairing, renovating and recycling items.

item.title: Breedon appoints former Amey director as head of health and safety
item.description: Breedon Group has named former Amey director Joe Docherty as its new group head of health and safety.

item.title: AtkinsRéalis bags £96m Herefordshire deal
item.description: AtkinsRéalis has been appointed as the sole provider for a £96m professional engineering services contract for Herefordshire Council.

item.title: Carillion chief executive fined £240,000 by FCA
item.description: Former Carillion chief executive Richard Howson has been fined nearly £240,000 by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for his part in misleading statements being issued by the company.

item.title: Generational partnership sees WSP win £12m contract extension in Leeds
item.description: WSP has been awarded a £12m four-year contract extension by Leeds City Council for its work supporting highways and transportation services in the city - the extension builds on more than 20 years of collaboration between the partners.
